_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pelican-eggs/minecraft (MIT).
name: Minecraft: BungeeCord
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: BungeeCord, the original Minecraft proxy that links servers into one network. Any build from its official build server.
startup: read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This server needs Java %s or newer, and it runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=4M -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxInlineLevel=15 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: BungeeCord. Downloads the chosen BungeeCord build from its
# official build server. Settings and plugins are never touched, and the
# jar is only replaced once the new one has downloaded whole.
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-bungeecord.jar}"
custom_url="${DL_PATH:-}"
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
sum() { "${1}sum" "$2" | cut -d' ' -f1; }
trap 'rm -f "$jar.new"; echo "The install stopped at line $LINENO of its script. Reinstall to try again."' ERR

# install_jar <url> <md5|sha1|sha256|sha512|none> <hash> <what>: skipped
# when the jar already matches; replaced only once the new one checks out.
install_jar() {
    if [ "$2" != none ] && [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sum "$2" "$jar")" = "$3" ]; then
        echo "$4 is already installed."
        return
    fi
    echo "Downloading $4"
    curl -fsSLg --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$1" || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ "$2" != none ] && [ "$(sum "$2" "$jar.new")" != "$3" ]; then
        rm -f "$jar.new"
        fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    unzip -tq "$jar.new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download isn't a valid jar. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
}

# The Java the jar needs, from its main class: the startup command checks it.
jar_java() {
    local main major
    main=$(unzip -p "$jar" META-INF/MANIFEST.MF 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^Main-Class: *//p' | head -n1) || true
    major=$(unzip -p "$jar" "${main//.//}.class" 2>/dev/null | od -An -j6 -N2 -tu1 | awk 'NF == 2 { print $1 * 256 + $2 - 44 }') || true
    echo "${major:-8}"
}

ci=https://ci.md-5.net/job/BungeeCord
if [ -n "${custom_url:-}" ]; then
    install_jar "$custom_url" none "" "the server jar from the download link"
else
    build="${BUNGEE_VERSION:-latest}"
    case "$build" in latest|lastStableBuild) build=lastStableBuild ;; lastSuccessfulBuild) ;; *[!0-9]*|"") fail "Version is latest or a BungeeCord build number, such as 1900." ;; esac
    info=$(get "$ci/$build/api/json?tree=number,result,artifacts%5BrelativePath%5D") ||
        fail "BungeeCord has no build $build. Set Version to latest, or to one of its build numbers."
    [ "$(jq -r .result <<<"$info")" = SUCCESS ] || fail "BungeeCord build $build didn't build successfully. Choose another build."
    number=$(jq -r .number <<<"$info")
    jq -e 'any(.artifacts[]; .relativePath == "bootstrap/target/BungeeCord.jar")' <<<"$info" >/dev/null ||
        fail "BungeeCord build $number has no server jar. Choose another build."
    # md_5's builds publish no checksum: the jar is checked to be whole, and
    # the build number is kept so a reinstall doesn't download it again.
    if [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-build 2>/dev/null)" = "$number" ]; then
        echo "BungeeCord build $number is already installed."
    else
        install_jar "$ci/$number/artifact/bootstrap/target/BungeeCord.jar" none "" "BungeeCord build $number"
        echo "$number" > .raptor-build
    fi
fi
java=$(jar_java)
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed BungeeCord${number:+ build $number}. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The BungeeCord build number, such as 1900, or latest for its newest stable build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to download the server jar from instead of BungeeCord's build server, which only staff can set.
